title: Erdős–Gyárfás Conjecture
next_action: PRIMARY: CLOSE THE PLANAR CASE. S032 left it as exactly two named conjectures which, with Heckman-Krakovski (every 3-connected cubic planar graph has a 2^m-cycle, 2<=m<=7), would settle statement 0.1 for ALL planar graphs with delta>=3 -- a real theorem nobody has. (i) Every 2-connected cubic planar graph has a power cycle. (ii) The L072 residual configuration does not occur: a MINIMUM planar counterexample that is not 2-connected is exactly two blocks of equal size (n+1)/2 meeting at a single cut vertex of degree 4, with deg_{B_i}(c)=2. Already in hand and to be used: L061 (planar delta>=4 has a C_4 or C_8), L071 (20m <= 39n - 78, plus the isolated-pentagon rule and the face lemma: a 5-face has at most 2 triangular neighbours, a 6-face at most 1, a 7-face none), L072's Step A doubling argument and its 2-edge-cut companion (the two sides' power-exponent sets are disjoint). HARD CONSTRAINTS, do not violate: L073 -- 'a planar counterexample is cubic' is FALSE (two buckyballs glued at a vertex), so Step C cannot be carried out from C_4/C_8-freeness at any level of discharging refinement; and both the buckyball and the truncated dodecahedron are 3-connected cubic planar with no C_4 and no C_8, one triangle-free and one pentagon-free, while every such graph has a 3-face or a 5-face -- so any complete planar proof MUST reach C_16 and beyond. Calibrate against those two and against Exoo's G_420 (3-connected cubic planar, no 2^m for m<=4). DISPROOF SIDE, the one live shape: a counterexample needs about log_2(n) gaps spread across the WHOLE cycle spectrum including the top. C052: the only known many-gaps family (arXiv:2506.09667) has ALL gaps in the first half, so its second half is a full interval of multiplicative width 2 and contains a power of two -- not a counterexample. The authors' own open problem, GAPS IN THE SECOND HALF OF THE CYCLE SPECTRUM of a hamiltonian-connected graph, is exactly the missing object; that is where a disproof would come from. DO NOT REOPEN: the (F) programme, case (5b), or any through-set/ear/theta/exchange/interference argument as a route to 0.1 (L059 -- the whole subdivision-covariant genre is incapable); additive surgeries on a minimum counterexample (L062); shortest-cycle anchors (L063); window/interval strengthenings at delta>=3 (L066); vertex substitution (L074 -- rho is exactly multiplicative, so iteration only increases it, and every rho=1 gadget reduces to a leaf gadget); the modular gadget channel (L064); SF4 as a REDUCTION (it is a strengthening, provably at least as hard as 0.1 -- it may still be pursued as a target, but never as a stepping stone). CALIBRATION OBJECTS: Exoo's G_78, G_450, G_420 (G018), plus the buckyball, the truncated dodecahedron and the order-24 graph of C051. Any drafted lemma that HOLDS on them is a soundness alarm.
